## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, the behavior before and after, and why this component owns the fix.

## Scope and tradeoffs

List affected components, dependencies, permissions, and relevant limitations. Explain any upstream contract or public API change. Keep unrelated work separate.

## Evidence

List commands actually run and outcomes, including relevant exit codes. Distinguish test fixtures, source inspection, and live verification. For visual changes, include genuine evidence with private content removed.

If measurements changed, link the reproducible input, command, estimator, and output. If verification was not possible, state why and which result remains unverified.

## Public and third-party content

Confirm examples and fixtures are fictional or already public. Describe any newly vendored material and its license/provenance. Do not attach real session logs, credentials, account data, or authenticated screenshots.

## Follow-up

Name any external approval, integration, recording, CI, or deployment step still needed. Do not mark it complete because this patch was accepted.

See the [contribution guide](https://github.com/gwsbhqt/oh-my-harness/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
